auditor_jane: Hi all — auditor needs a mapped evidence package for last week's RBAC changes and the KMS key-binding we rolled out. They asked for: 1) PRs and approval logs for RBAC/iam changes; 2) audit trail snippets showing KMS key usage by the service principal; 3) SIEM saved-search or query used to tie key usage to incidents; 4) retention proof and archived snapshot location. Deadline EOD Wed. Can we collect a sampled snapshot + pointer to full archive?

mike_s: Yep. We can provide sampled snapshots plus the full archive location. Do they want signed manifests or just links?

auditor_jane: Signed manifests preferred where possible. Also please include cross-reference to the incident ticket if any KMS activity was part of a triage.

sam_l: Quick Q — which environments should we include? prod only or prod+staging? Auditors usually want prod, but sometimes want staging for change testing evidence.

mike_s: Let's include prod primary and a staging sample. I'll assemble: PR list, approver audit entries (GitHub check), IAM/role binding diff, CloudTrail snippets for KMS usage, and the SIEM query we used for the alert mapping.

leo_infra: Evidence locations:
- PRs/approvals: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/2487 (approved by @sam_l, @mike_s)
- IAM diff + RBAC change: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/commit/5a1b2c3 (see comment thread)
- Evidence bundle (full archive): s3://redwood-audit-packages/2026-03-20/rbac-kms-archive.tar.gz
- Sample snapshot (signed manifest): s3://redwood-audit-packages/2026-03-20/samples/manifest-20260320.json (pgp-signed)

mike_s: CloudTrail snippet (sample) — this is the exact query I used in our Splunk/CloudWatch logs to extract KMS usage by the service principal: 
```
# Splunk example
index=aws_cloudtrail eventSource=kms.amazonaws.com (eventName=Encrypt OR eventName=Decrypt OR eventName=GenerateDataKey) resourceName="alias/rdw-service" userIdentity.arn="arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/rdw-service/*"
| table _time, eventName, userIdentity.principalId, userIdentity.arn, sourceIPAddress, resources, requestParameters
```
Or AWS CLI whoami for direct lookup: 
```
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=ResourceName,AttributeValue=arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:alias/rdw-service --start-time 2026-03-14T00:00:00Z --end-time 2026-03-20T23:59:59Z
```
Use both: Splunk for the SIEM snapshot, CLI for raw event export.

sam_l: Auditors sometimes ask for proof of least-privilege — include the role policy that the service uses and the PR comment where we scoped permissions. Also include the change window + who acknowledged.

mike_s: Added. Role policy file: s3://redwood-artifacts/iam/policies/rdw-service-role-20260319.json. Change window recorded in runbook: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/Sec/Change+2026-03-19-RBAC-KMS. Approvals: GitHub approvals + the change request ticket #CHG-1123.

auditor_jane: For SIEM linkage, can you provide the saved search or Kibana/CloudWatch Insights query text and a one-paragraph explanation of how it maps to control ID scoping? They want control mapping references (SOC2 CC6.1/ISO A.9.2 equivalents).

mike_s: SIEM query (CloudWatch Insights example): 
```
fields @timestamp, @message
| filter eventSource = "kms.amazonaws.com" and (eventName = "Encrypt" or eventName = "Decrypt" or eventName = "GenerateDataKey")
| parse requestParameters.* as params
| display @timestamp, userIdentity.arn, eventName, sourceIPAddress, resources
```
Control mapping blurb (short): This search demonstrates that we can detect KMS key lifecycle usage and tie usage to identities (userIdentity.arn) to satisfy audit trail requirements for cryptographic operations (SOC2 CC6.1 / ISO A.10.1). Will add this to the manifest.

leo_infra: Retention proof: S3 lifecycle policy screenshot and bucket policy exported: s3://redwood-audit-packages/2026-03-20/retention/bucket-policy.json. Retention is 7 years (archival-tier after 90 days). Archived manifest includes md5/sha256 checksums.

mike_s: Packaging script we used to build the sample bundle:
```
./scripts/build-evidence.sh --include=pr,approvals,iam,cloudtrail,kms --start=2026-03-14 --end=2026-03-20 --output=/tmp/rbac-kms-sample.tar.gz
# sign
gpg --output /tmp/rbac-kms-sample.tar.gz.sig --detach-sig /tmp/rbac-kms-sample.tar.gz
```

deploy_bot: New object uploaded: s3://redwood-audit-packages/2026-03-20/samples/rbac-kms-sample-20260320.tar.gz (manifest: s3://redwood-audit-packages/2026-03-20/samples/manifest-20260320.json)

mike_s: OK — I've dropped the signed manifest link in the ticket CHG-1123 and attached the sample snapshot. I'll DM @auditor_jane the PGP-signed manifest and the full S3 archive path. Sam — can you take a staging snapshot at 16:00 PST and confirm logs are retained as expected?

sam_l: Will do. I'll post confirmation when snapshot is uploaded.

auditor_jane: Thanks — this looks good. Once I validate the manifest I'll request the formal handoff. If anything else crops up I will ping here. :thumbsup:
